# Bank of Z — Copilot instructions

Bank of Z is an IBM Z sample banking application: COBOL on **CICS** (3270 screens + DB2), COBOL / PL/I / Java on **IMS** (DL/I databases), a **batch** statement job, and **z/OS Connect** REST APIs in front of both. In this fork it is used as the legacy system for a GitHub Copilot app-modernization workshop.

## Layout

| Path | What lives there |
|---|---|
| `src/base/cics/cobol/` | CICS programs. `BNK1*` = 3270 front-ends, `BNKMENU` = main menu, back-ends like `INQCUST`, `XFRFUN`, `DBCRFUN`; `ABNDPROC` records abends |
| `src/base/cics/copy/`, `src/base/ims/copy/` | Copybooks (record layouts, COMMAREAs, DB2 host variables) |
| `src/base/cics/bms/` | BMS maps; their symbolic-map copybooks are generated at build time and are **not** in the repo |
| `src/base/ims/` | IMS: `cobol/` (`IB*` message programs, `LOAD*` loaders), `pli/`, `java/`, `DBD/` + `PSB/` (assembler) |
| `src/base/batch/` | Statement batch: `BNKSTMTC` (COBOL), `BNKSTMTP` (PL/I), JCL |
| `src/base/mq/java/` | MQ transfer clients |
| `src/api/` | z/OS Connect OpenAPI + operation mappings. `providerFiles/gen` is generated |
| `.setup/` | z/OS build / deploy automation (DB2 DDL in `.setup/jcl/*/Db2-create.j2`) |
| `docs/docs/` | Upstream Bank of Z documentation site — not workshop output |
| `docs/modernization/` | Workshop output: `00-source-of-truth/` (generated by cobol-rekt), `01-rediscovery/` … `04-deploy/` |

## Conventions

- Fixed-format COBOL: columns 1–6 sequence area, column 7 indicator (`*` / `/` = comment), code in 8–72. Preserve this when you show or write COBOL.
- Business errors are reported through COMMAREA flags (`COMM-SUCCESS`, `COMM-FAIL-CODE`), technical errors through `RESP` / `SQLCODE` checks that `LINK` to `ABNDPROC` and `ABEND`.
- Money is fixed-point (`PIC S9(10)V99`). Never describe or convert it as floating point.
- Copybooks are resolved by member name; if a name exists in `src/base/*/copy/` and in `src/api/**/providerFiles/`, the `src/base` one is authoritative.

## How to work in this repo

- **Cite** every claim about the code as `path/to/file:LINE`.
- **Facts before interpretation.** If `docs/modernization/00-source-of-truth/` exists, check claims about control flow, decisions, data items, calls and table access against it. Contradictions go to `docs/modernization/01-rediscovery/open-questions.md` — do not silently resolve them.
- **Do not modify legacy sources** (`src/`, `.setup/`) unless explicitly asked. Rediscovery is read-only.
- **Never guess** program names, transaction IDs, codes or field meanings. Say "unknown" and ask.
- No mainframe is attached to this workshop: do not try to compile, deploy, or run CICS / IMS / DB2 commands.
- Skills in `.github/skills/`: `cobol-rekt` (source of truth), `cobol-dependency-scan` (quick dependency list), `copybook-resolver` (layouts). Agents in `.github/agents/`, phase prompts in `.github/prompts/`.
